thread:
Maya (AE): Hey team — Customer ACME's POC subscription ends next Wednesday. They want a clean cut: invalidate hosted API keys, tear down the dedicated pool we provisioned, and confirm any retained data. Can we list exact steps + owners?

Jonas (SE): Timeline agreed — target teardown Thu 09:00 UTC. Quick checklist from my side: 
- Hosted: revoke API keys, disable any active API tokens, and delete POC service accounts.
- Dedicated: schedule a graceful drain -> stop new allocations -> snapshot model state if needed -> delete pool.
- Private/VPC: coordinate with Luis for peering teardown and security group cleanup.

Priya (Eng-Infra): +1. Add-ons: ensure KV/prefix caches are purged, and any persistent cache buckets removed. For Dedicated pool teardown I'll run: 
```
# drain nodes
ri infra pools drain --pool poc-acme --wait
# take model checkpoint (if requested)
ri infra snapshots create --pool poc-acme --name pre-teardown-$(date +%F)
# delete pool
ri infra pools delete --pool poc-acme --confirm
```
Note: deletion is irreversible. Confirm snapshots retention or transfer.

Sasha (CISO): We need to preserve audit logs for 90 days unless legal says otherwise. Also: confirm no PII remains in retained snapshots/backups. If anything needs legal hold -> do not delete.

Luis (Customer IT): FYI — we'll need the exact list of keys and the service account names to validate our side. Also for VPC peer: we require a 24h maintenance window. Can you send the planned window?

Maya (AE): Planned teardown Thu 09:00–11:00 UTC. Luis, ok with that window?

Luis (Customer IT): 09:00–11:00 UTC works. We will also run an internal scan for secrets after your revoke. Please provide the key names.

Jonas (SE): Hosted key revoke example (we'll also remove from console): 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/keys/revoke \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"key_id":"poc-acme-hosted-2024"}'
```
After revoke, wait 10m and verify 401 responses for previous key.

Priya (Eng-Infra): Dedicated pool checklist (detailed):
- Mark pool read-only and stop accepts -> run drain command.
- Wait for inflight requests < 1% over 10m.
- Export usage logs to S3 for 30d retention -> confirm with Sasha if 90d needed.
- Snapshot models + configs -> store in customer-owned bucket if requested.
- Delete pool and associated persistent volumes.
- Revoke any upload/ingest service principals created for the POC.

Sasha (CISO): If snapshots contain model-generated content, that may include customer data. Redact or export to customer bucket only. We insist on an audit CSV listing: keys revoked, pools deleted, backups removed, peers disconnected.

Maya (AE): Owners: Jonas -> Hosted keys + API-side verification. Priya -> Dedicated pool drain/delete + infra cleanup. Luis -> VPC peer teardown + internal scan. Sasha -> approve audit retention & final sign-off. I'll coordinate comms with legal.

Luis (Customer IT): Can you confirm data retention policy? POC data created via Hosted API — is any of that retained beyond the 30d logs?

Jonas (SE): Default: request logs/metadata retained 30 days. We don't keep customer request/response blobs beyond opt-in snapshots. If they opted in to telemetry, we have an entry in the account metadata — we'll flush that. We'll run data purge: 
```
# purge logs for acct
ri compliance purge-requests --account acme-poc --before 2025-01-01
```
Note: final purge takes up to 48h to cascade.

Sasha (CISO): Approve 90d audit log hold but require a hashed index so we can show proof-of-deletion later for the payloads. Also, add a line item: rotate root admin token after teardown.

Priya (Eng-Infra): Scheduling note: I'll start drain at Thu 09:00 UTC, snapshot at 09:10, and delete at 10:30 if no holds. If Sasha/Legal request hold we will pause deletion.

Maya (AE): Pricing/refunds: ACME asked if we pro-rate the Dedicated pool for last week unused — finance gave a credit playbook. I'll file separate convo but outcome won't block teardown.

deploy-bot: Scheduled: infra.poc-acme.pool.drain job queued for 2028-04-18T09:00:00Z (run id: db-8821).

Luis (Customer IT): Thanks — please send the list of service principals and keys now so we can cross-check before 09:00.

Jonas (SE): Sending in DM (sensitive). Public list: poc-acme-hosted-2024 (hosted key), svc-poc-acme-ingest (service principal), pool:poc-acme-dedicated.

Maya (AE): Quick reminder checklist for post-teardown (to confirm in thread):
- [ ] Hosted keys revoked and verified (Jonas)
- [ ] Dedicated pool deleted (Priya)
- [ ] Snapshots handled (customer bucket or deleted) (Priya/Luis)
- [ ] VPC peering removed (Luis)
- [ ] Audit CSV uploaded to legal (Maya/Sasha)
- [ ] Root admin token rotated (Sasha/Jonas)
- [ ] Customer confirms no outstanding data/legal hold (Luis/Maya)

Sasha (CISO): One more: create JIRA ticket for compliance evidence and link to audit CSV.

Maya (AE): I'll run through and post final status here after the deletion. If any holds pop up we stop. :white_check_mark:

Luis (Customer IT): All good, we'll monitor. Thanks for the clear plan.

Priya (Eng-Infra): Will post logs + final deletion ack (timestamped) in this thread once complete.

Jonas (SE): I'll run the revoke script at 09:00 and verify 401s by 09:15.

Maya (AE): Perfect — locking window. Thanks everyone.
